profile.title: Synthetic locator, relay, and collector cluster

validity.physiological_state: abstract local topology without anatomical geometry or channel physics
validity.description: Checks deterministic route selection, bounded store-and-forward relay behavior, trace preservation, and aggregated communication metrics.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.2 replaceable one-hop communication contract
sources.role: per-hop delivery result and metric foundation

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.3 bounded cluster communication contract
sources.role: synthetic topology, routing, relay, and acceptance rules

limitations: All topology, latency, energy, and outcome values are synthetic deterministic verification values.
Route selection uses declared directed links and does not infer anatomical proximity or physical reachability.
Relays forward immediately without queues, contention, congestion, interference, or security processing.
The cluster ends at a local collector and does not yet include an active gateway, BAN, or external station.
